messages:
mateo: Heads-up TandemSI signed LOE for marketplace listing next week, they surfaced a CUDA12.2 + driver 535 regression on their 80GB infer nodes. we should pin and prepare a hotfix-routing fallback.
emily: ouch. do we have a repro or crash logs?
mateo: they uploaded a short trace to the partner bucket, link: https://partners.tandemsi.example/bug/4221 — signs point to kernel timeout in 535.86 under long-seq workloads.
raj: if it's a kernel timeout we can route TandemSI org traffic to fallback driver 530.41 during the launch window. that avoids a full rollback of the marketplace image.
susan: vendor has a patch candidate but ETA is 48-72h. can we do a temporary pins + canary?
integrations-bot: NOTE: marketplace canary window free for TandemSI org: next-deploy slot 2026-04-10T03:00Z -> 2026-04-10T09:00Z
mateo: plan proposal: 1) pin driver to 530.41 for TandemSI org on marketplace layer (routing policy) 2) apply canary with 10% traffic to 535.86 + KV cache disabled 3) if stable, lift pin; else, apply vendor patch when available.
emily: +1. need a compact config snippet to hand to infra.
raj: here's a draft patch for routing policy we can push to marketplace config (replace ORG_ID):
```
route_rules:
  - match: org == "TANDEM_ORG_ID"
    driver_pin: "530.41"
    priority: 10
  - match: org == "TANDEM_ORG_ID" and canary == true
    driver_pin: "535.86"
    kv_cache: false
    priority: 20
```

susan: i'll ping TandemSI PM and vendor. tagging @vendor-eng and @tandem-pm in the partner thread. they need the repro and the kernel logs.
devops-oncall: will create the marketplace rollout job and the ephemeral route. i'll set up rollback hooks and a smoke test: `run-smoke --org TANDEM_ORG_ID --seq 1024`.
mateo: great — owners: susan (partner comms + vendor patch tracking), raj (routing config + canary ops), devops-oncall (rollout job + smoke tests). emily will validate perf/latency delta on pinned driver.
susan: noted. i'll schedule a short sync with TandemSI for 10:30 PT today.
emily: small caveat: pinning may increase token latency ~5-8% on some models; will surface in the dashboard.
mateo: acceptable for launch if stable. if vendor patch arrives sooner we can move back. i'll update the partner launch checklist and the joint-announce timeline.
integrations-bot: ACTION CREATED: marketplace-route/TANDEM-530-pin assigned to raj, due 2026-04-09T23:59Z
raj: starting work now, will post PR + deploy plan in this thread.
mateo: thanks all. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
